payload_field '{}' exists for type '{}' but is not an object (found: {}), skipping line\",\n                                    envelope_cfg.payload_field, type_str, value_desc\n                                )\n                            } else {\n                                format!(\n                                    \"Envelope payload_field '{}' missing for type '{}', skipping line\",\n                                    envelope_cfg.payload_field, type_str\n                                )\n                            };\n                            warn!(\"{}\", warning_msg);\n                            return Ok(Vec::new());\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    // Unknown routing (shouldn't happen due to get_routing defaults, but handle defensively)\n                    return Ok(Vec::new());\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // No envelope: both envelope_json and payload_json point to the full line\n            (None, &raw_json)\n        };\n\n        // Check type filter (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        if let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.include_types {\n            let type_field = &filter.field;\n            if let Some(type_val) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                if !filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n                    return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.exclude_types {\n            let type_field = &filter.field;\n            if let Some(type_val) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                if filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n                    return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Parse timestamp (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let ts = if let Some(ref ts_field) = plugin.parser.timestamp {\n            parse_timestamp_with_envelope(ts_field, payload_json, envelope_json).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Timestamp error: {}\", e),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Utc::now() // Fallback - shouldn't happen with validation\n        };\n\n        // Parse role (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let role_str = if let Some(ref role_field) = plugin.parser.role {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(role_field, payload_json, envelope_json).ok_or_else(\n                || {\n                    AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                        &context.source_file,\n                        line_number,\n                        format!(\"Role field '{}' not found\", role_field),\n                    )\n                },\n            )?\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No role field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Apply role mapping\n        let role = if let Some(mapped) = plugin.parser.role_map.get(&role_str) {\n            Role::from_str(mapped).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role mapping: {}\", mapped),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Role::from_str(&role_str).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role: {}\", role_str),\n                )\n            })?\n        };\n\n        // Parse content (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let content = if let Some(ref content_field) = plugin.parser.content {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(content_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No content field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Build base event\n        let mut event = Event::new(\n            ts,\n            context.session_id.clone(),\n            context.source_agent.clone(),\n            role,\n            content,\n        );\n\n        // Extract tool name (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        // Note: This extraction is not restricted to tool_call/tool_result roles to allow\n        // the tool_name field to be used for general envelope field extraction (e.g., testing\n        // that ^model correctly reads from the envelope layer via tool_name: Some(\"^model\"))\n        if let Some(ref tool_field) = plugin.parser.tool_name {\n            if let Some(tool_name) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(tool_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                event.tool = Some(tool_name);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract tokens (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let tokens_in = plugin.parser.tokens_in.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n        let tokens_out = plugin.parser.tokens_out.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n\n        if tokens_in.is_some() || tokens_out.is_some() {\n            event.tokens = Some(TokenCounts {\n                input: tokens_in.unwrap_or(0),\n                output: tokens_out.unwrap_or(0),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Set project from context\n        event.project = context.project.clone();\n\n        // Set model from context\n        event.model = context.model.clone();\n\n        // Add static fields\n        for (key, value) in &plugin.parser.static_fields {\n            match key.as_str() {\n                \"source_agent\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        // Only override if we don't already have a subagent suffix\n                        // The ParseContext sets source_agent with \"-subagent\" suffix for subagent files,\n                        // and we need to preserve that instead of overwriting with the static value\n                        if !event.source_agent.ends_with(\"-subagent\") {\n                            event.source_agent = s.to_string();\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                \"source_version\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_version = Some(s.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Handle event expansion for compound events (e.g., Claude Code tool_use blocks)\n        // For now, return single event - expansion can be added per-agent\n        Ok(vec![event])\n    }\n}\n\nimpl super::FormatParser for JsonlParser {\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let reader = open_file_maybe_zst(source_path)?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Get session ID from filename\n        let session_id = match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // For subagent sessions, include parent directory in session ID\n                        // to maintain hierarchy and avoid collisions\n                        if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n                            // Extract path from \"projects/<project>/<parent>/subagents/<agent>.jsonl\"\n                            // to get \"<parent>/<agent>\"\n source_path\n                                        .file_stem()\n                                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                        .to_string()\n                                })\n                        } else {\n                            // For main sessions, use just the filename\n                            source_path\n                                .file_stem()\n                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                .to_string()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(_) => {\n                        // Need to read first line to get session ID\n                        \"unknown\".to_string() // Will be updated during parsing\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n        };\n\n        // Adjust source_agent for subagent files\n        let source_agent = if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n            format!(\"{}-subagent\", plugin.plugin.name.clone())\n        } else {\n            plugin.plugin.name.clone()\n        };\n\n        let context =\n            ParseContext::new(session_id, source_agent, source_path.display().to_string());\n\n        for {\n                    eprintln!(\n                        \"Warning: Read error at {}:{} - {}\",\n                        source_path.display(),\n                        line_num,\n                        e\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n e.is_skippable() {\n                        eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn parse_incremental(\n        &self,\n        source_path: &Path,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n        start_offset: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        // For incremental parsing, open file at offset and read only new lines\n        let reader = open_file_at_offset(source_path, start_offset)?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Get session ID from filename (same logic as parse())\n        let session_id = match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => match session_id_from {\n                SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                    if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n                        derive_subagent_ids(source_path)\n                            .map(|(session_id, _parent)| session_id)\n                            .unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                                source_path\n                                    .file_stem()\n                                    .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                    .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                    .to_string()\n                            })\n                    } else {\n                        source_path\n                            .file_stem()\n                            .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                            .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                            .to_string()\n                    }\n                }\n                SessionIdSource::Field(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n            },\n            _ => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n        };\n\n        let source_agent = if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n            format!(\"{}-subagent\", plugin.plugin.name.clone())\n        } else {\n            plugin.plugin.name.clone()\n        };\n\n        let context =\n            ParseContext::new(session_id, source_agent, source_path.display().to_string());\n\n        // Read lines incrementally from the offset position\n        // Note: line numbers here are relative to the new content, not the full file\n        for (line_num, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {\n            let line_num = line_num + 1; // 1-indexed for error messages\n            let line = match line_result {\n                Ok(l) => l,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    // Don't spam warnings for incremental read errors at EOF\n                    if e.kind() != std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof {\n                        warn!(\n                            \"Read error at {}:{} (offset {}) - {}\",\n                            source_path.display(),\n                            line_num,\n                            start_offset,\n  }\n\n            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        // Log at warn level instead of eprintln to respect tracing filters\n                        warn!(\"{}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // For subagent sessions, include parent directory in session ID\n                        // to maintain hierarchy and avoid collisions\n                        if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n                            // Extract path from \".../<parent>/subagents/<agent>.jsonl\"\n                            // to get \"<parent>/<agent>\"\n                            derive_subagent_ids(source_path)\n                                .map(|(session_id, _parent)| session_id)\n                                .unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                                    source_path\n                                        .file_stem()\n                                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                        .to_string()\n                                })\n                        } else {\n                            source_path\n                                .file_stem()\n                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                .to_string()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value = extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                                &envelope_cfg.type_field,\n                                                &json,\n                                                Some(&json),\n                                            )\n                                            .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                //\n                // Subagent files are at: .../<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                //\n                // ROOT CAUSE FIX (bead bf-1pkfp):\n                // The previous implementation required:\n                // 1. At least 2 components before \"subagents\" (subagents_idx >= 2)\n                // 2. A \"projects\" directory somewhere before the parent session\n                //\n                // This caused test fixtures and non-standard directory structures to fail\n                // parent_session_id extraction because they didn't match the exact production\n                // layout of ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                // THE FIX:\n                // - Removed the \"projects\" directory requirement entirely\n                // - Reduced minimum components before \"subagents\" from 2 to 1\n                // - Directly extract parent session ID as the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                //\n                // This allows subagent detection to work for both:\n                // - Production paths: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                // - Test paths: /tmp/.../sessions/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        // We need at least 1 component before \"subagents\": .../<parent-session>/subagents/...\n                        if subagents_idx >= 1 {\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n                            // The parent session is the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                            let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n\n                            components\n                                .get(parent_idx)\n                                .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n    use crate::plugin::{\n        LogFormat, Parser, Plugin, PluginMeta, SessionDetection, SessionIdSource, }\n141\t}\n142\t\n143\t/// Parse timestamp from various formats\n144\tpub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n145\t    let ts_str = extract_string(value, path)\n146\t        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n147\t\n148\t    // Try ISO 8601 first\n149\t    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n150\t        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n151\t    }\n152\t\n153\t    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n154\t    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n155\t        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n156\t            // Milliseconds\n157\t            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n158\t        } else {\n159\t            // Seconds\n160\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n161\t        };\n162\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n163\t    }\n164\t\n165\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n166\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n167\t        return Ok(dt);\n168\t    }\n169\t\n170\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n171\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n172\t        ts_str\n173\t    )))\n174\t}\n175\t\n176\t/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n177\t///\n178\t/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n179\t/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n180\t/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n181\t/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n182\t///\n183\t/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n184\t/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n185\t/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n186\t/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n187\t///\n188\t/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n189\t/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n190\t///\n191\t/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n192\t/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\n193\tpub fn extract_with_envelope(\n194\t    path: &str,\n195\t    payload: &Value,\n196\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n197\t) -> Option<Value> {\n198\t    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n199\t        // Strip the caret prefix\n200\t        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n201\t            // Try envelope first\n202\t            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n203\t                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n204\t                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n205\t                }\n206\t            }\n207\t            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n208\t            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n209\t        } else {\n210\t            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n211\t            None\n212\t        }\n213\t    } else {\n214\t        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n215\t        extract_field(payload, path)\n216\t    }\n217\t}\n218\t\n219\t/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n220\t///\n221\t/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n222\t/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\n223\tpub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n224\t    path: &str,\n225\t    payload: &Value,\n226\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n227\t) -> Option<String> {\n228\t    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n229\t    match value {\n230\t        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n231\t        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n232\t        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n233\t        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n234\t        Value::Array(arr) => {\n235\t            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n236\t            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n237\t            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n238\t                .iter()\n239\t                .filter_map(|item| {\n240\t                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n241\t                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n242\t                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n243\t                            return obj\n244\t                                .get(\"text\")\n245\t                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n246\t                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n247\t                        }\n248\t                    }\n249\t                    None\n250\t                })\n251\t                .collect();\n252\t            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n253\t                None\n254\t            } else {\n255\t                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n256\t            }\n257\t        }\n258\t        _ => None,\n259\t    }\n260\t}\n261\t\n262\t/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n263\t///\n264\t/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n265\t/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n266\t/// UTC-naive formats.\n267\tpub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n268\t    path: &str,\n269\t    payload: &Value,\n270\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n271\t) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n272\t    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n273\t        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n274\t\n275\t    // Try ISO 8601 first\n276\t    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n277\t        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n278\t    }\n279\t\n280\t    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n281\t    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n282\t        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n283\t            // Milliseconds\n284\t            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n285\t        } else {\n286\t            // Seconds\n287\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n288\t        };\n289\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n293\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n294\t        return Ok(dt);\n295\t    }\n296\t\n297\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n298\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n299\t        ts_str\n300\t    )))\n301\t}\n302\t\n303\t/// Base trait for all format parsers\n304\tpub trait FormatParser {\n305\t    /// Parse events from the source\n306\t    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n307\t\n308\t    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n309\t    ///\n310\t    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n311\t    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n312\t    ///\n313\t    /// # Arguments\n314\t    ///\n315\t    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n316\t    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n317\t    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n318\t    ///\n319\t    /// # Returns\n320\t    ///\n321\t    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n322\t    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n323\t    fn parse_incremental(\n324\t        &self,\n325\t        source_path: &Path,\n326\t        plugin: &Plugin,\n327\t        start_offset: u64,\n328\t    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n329\t        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n330\t        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n331\t        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n332\t    }\n333\t\n334\t    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n335\t    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n336\t}\n337\t\n338\t/// pub end_offset: u64,\n345\t    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n346\t    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n347\t    /// is a child of another session)\n348\t    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n349\t}\n350\t\n351\t#[cfg(test)]\n352\tmod tests {\n353\t    use super::*;\n354\t    use serde_json::json;\n355\t\n356\t    #[test]\n357\t    fn extract_field(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<Value> {\n    if path.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let mut current = value;\n    for part in path.split('.') {\n        // Handle
